tools.name: SearchDocuments
tools.description:
Search the user's Glean enterprise index and return ranked results.

Results are permission-filtered to the authorized user. Use 'offset' with
'limit' to page; 'has_next_page' indicates more results remain. Offset
paging is supported up to roughly 2000 results (20 pages x 100 items);
deeper offsets raise an error rather than return a misleading empty page.
When the fetch budget is exhausted before the requested window is filled,
the tool raises rather than return a partial page (fail loud over mislead).
The result list is trimmed to a size budget when items are large;
'truncated' flags it and 'has_next_page' stays true so the caller can page
or narrow the query.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Natural-language search query to run against the user's Glean index.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-100). Defaults to 10.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: 0-indexed position of the first result to return. Defaults to 0 (first result).

output.description: Ranked Glean results plus pagination metadata. 'has_next_page' is true when more results are available (page with a larger 'offset'); 'truncated' is true when the result list was trimmed to fit a response-size budget.

summary:
## Glean Toolkit

Arcade toolkit that exposes the Glean Client API, enabling search over a Glean enterprise knowledge index on behalf of authenticated users.

## Capabilities

- **Enterprise search:** Query the Glean index and receive ranked, permission-filtered results scoped to the authorized user.
- **Pagination:** Offset-based paging via `offset` and `limit`; `has_next_page` signals remaining results. Supported up to ~2 000 results (≈20 pages × 100 items); deeper offsets raise an explicit error.
- **Result budgeting:** When the fetch budget is exhausted before the requested window is filled, the tool raises rather than returns a partial page. When items are large, the result list is trimmed to a size budget, flagged via `truncated`, with `has_next_page` kept accurate so callers can continue paging or narrow the query.

## OAuth

Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 via **Glean** as the provider. Users must authorize the Arcade app through Glean's OAuth flow before search requests can be made on their behalf.

## Secrets

- **`GLEAN_API_URL`** — The base URL for your organization's Glean API endpoint (e.g., `https://<your-org>.glean.com/api`). Glean deployments are tenant-specific, so there is no single global URL. Obtain this value from your Glean administrator or from the Glean admin console under your organization's API settings. See [Glean's API documentation](https://developers.glean.com/docs/client_api/client_api_overview/) for guidance on locating the correct endpoint for your tenant.

For configuring secrets in Arcade, see the [Arcade secrets guide](https://docs.arcade.dev/en/guides/create-tools/tool-basics/create-tool-secrets). You can also manage secrets directly at [https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets](https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets).
